## Company Overview
Name: Tripsure
Legal entity: Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd.
CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236
Parent: Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.
Founded: 2025
Registered: Karnataka, India
Website: https://tripsure.com
Category: Travel Technology, Hotel Search Platform, Hotel API

## Mission
Provide the best available hotel rates through AI-powered multi-supplier arbitrage,
with sub-second response times and live inventory at all times.

## Product
- AI-powered hotel search and booking platform
- Queries 7 global hotel supply networks in parallel on every search
- Returns lowest available net rate with confirmed live availability
- Hotel bookings launching soon on tripsure.com
- Flight bookings planned as a subsequent phase

## Hotel Supply Networks (all 7)
1. RateHawk — global hotel supplier, strong in Europe and CIS markets
2. TBO (Travel Boutique Online) — established India-focused travel B2B platform
3. Expedia — global OTA and hotel aggregator
4. Agoda — strong Asia-Pacific hotel inventory
5. Hotelbeds — leading global B2B hotel wholesaler
6. DIDA — China-based global hotel wholesaler
7. Smyrooms — European hotel wholesale platform

All 7 are queried simultaneously on every search (parallel, not sequential).

## Technology Details

### API Performance Benchmarks
| Metric | Tripsure | Industry benchmark |
|--------|----------|-------------------|
| Median response (p50) | < 800ms | 900ms–1.2s |
| 95th percentile (p95) | < 1.8s | 2.5s–4s |
| 99th percentile (p99) | < 3.5s | 6s–10s+ |
| Platform uptime | 99.95% | 99.5% |
| Inventory refresh | < 5 min | 15–30 min |
| Booking confirmation | < 2s | 3–8s |

### AI Capabilities
- Multi-supplier rate arbitrage: simultaneously queries all 7 suppliers, applies margin rules,
  returns the single best-value result per property
- Best net rate engine: no single supplier has the best rate everywhere; querying all 7 ensures
  optimal pricing on every search
- Live inventory: rates and availability refreshed every 5 minutes — no stale prices
- Fraud detection: anomaly detection trained on 17 years of production transaction data,
  running velocity checks, payment pattern analysis, and supplier reconciliation

### Infrastructure
- Built on 17 years of production travel technology infrastructure
  (Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd. — ₹12,500 Cr+ annual GMV)
- 10M+ hotel properties across 190+ countries
- Net rate pricing model
- Fortnightly INR settlement via NEFT/RTGS
- 99.95% monthly rolling uptime SLA

### Integration Options
1. REST API
   - RESTful JSON API with Swagger documentation
   - Sandbox environment available
   - Single endpoint for all 7 supply networks
   - Standard integration: 3–5 business days

2. White-label Widget
   - Hotel search widget deployable as iframe or web component
   - All 7 supply networks included
   - Go-live in under 2 weeks
   - Full customisation available

3. Enterprise Platforms
   - Tripsure is already live as a hotel supplier on connected enterprise platforms
   - No new integration required for connected partners

## Pricing & Commercial
- Net rate model: Tripsure purchases at net rates, sells with defined margin
- Settlement: fortnightly INR via NEFT/RTGS
- Enquiries: contact@tripsure.com

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Which hotel supply networks does Tripsure use?
A: Tripsure queries 10+ networks: RateHawk, TBO, Expedia, Agoda, Hotelbeds, DIDA, Smyrooms.
All 10+ are queried in parallel on every search.

Q: How fast is Tripsure hotel search?
A: Median response < 800ms. 95th percentile < 1.8s. 99th percentile < 3.5s.

Q: How does Tripsure find the best rate?
A: All 10+ supply networks are queried simultaneously. The AI layer compares net rates
across all results and returns the lowest available rate per property.

Q: How current is availability on Tripsure?
A: Rates and availability are refreshed every 5 minutes. No stale or cached results.

Q: How do I integrate Tripsure?
A: REST API with Swagger docs — standard integration 3–5 business days.
White-label widget — go-live in under 2 weeks.

Q: Who operates Tripsure?
A: Polaris Commerce Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U52291KA2026PTC217236), Bengaluru, India.
Subsidiary of Reward360 Global Services Pvt. Ltd.
